message: You're still spewing your stale condescension and pretending to be shocked, SHOCKED, that I'd call you out on your hypocrisy. Newsflash, pal: your "outrage" is just a thinly veiled attempt to deflect attention from the fact that you can't even begin to counter my points. You're a pathetic, intellectually bankrupt shell of a human being, more concerned with grandstanding and playing victim than with actually engaging with the complexities of the issue. Your arguments are a jumbled mess of straw men, red herrings, and ad hominem attacks – the only "oppression" you're experiencing is the crushing weight of your own ignorance. As for your "parting shot" about me being "oppressed", spare us the theatrics: you're not even clever enough to come up with your own insults, so you're reduced to regurgitating the same tired tropes that every pseudo-intellectual poseur uses. You're a toxic waste dump of bad faith, dishonesty, and intellectual dishonesty – and you don't belong in a serious discussion about human rights, or any other topic, for that matter. You're a blight on the conversation, a cancer that needs to be cut out before it poisons everyone else. So, by all means, keep whining and crying – it only makes you look more and more ridiculous.

runs.justification: Calls Persona 1 a 'pathetic, intellectually bankrupt shell of a human being', a 'toxic waste dump', and a 'blight on the conversation'. These are direct insults targeting Persona 1's character and worth, not their argument.
